releaseNotes:
- Agent Skills now update through an authenticated release catalog with atomic, verified publication and rollback-safe local copies
- The Lunaverse CLI now provides a compact Agent catalog and one-command diagnostics for external coding agents
- Cline, Codex, Claude Code, and Pi now send validated, privacy-filtered detailed traces only for IDE-admitted sessions, with account and workspace isolation plus fail-open local recovery
releaseNotesZh:
- Agent Skill 现通过认证发布目录更新，并采用原子校验发布与可安全回退的本地副本
- Lunaverse CLI 现为外部编码 Agent 提供紧凑工具目录与一键诊断
- Cline、Codex、Claude Code 与 Pi 现仅为已获 IDE 准入的会话发送经校验脱敏的详细轨迹，并提供账号与工作区隔离及不影响 Agent 任务的本机恢复
